experience.title: THE LEGACY STRIKES BACK
paragraphs: Five years ago an intern joined a bank reconciliation company in Fortaleza. The systems were vast, the legacy ran deep, and the monolith had stood unchallenged for years.
He helped take it apart. What was once a single Angular system became an independent microservice with its own API, and its frontend was rebuilt in React while the business kept running.
Today he is the technical reference on the client onboarding portal he has grown with since its early days — shaping architecture decisions, running technical discovery, and shipping to production.
experience.timelineSubtitle: Five years in fintech: bank reconciliation and payment operator integrations.
highlights: Technical reference on the client onboarding portal, which automates integrations with payment operators.
Took part in splitting an Angular monolith into a microservice with its own API, and in migrating its AngularJS frontend to React.
Architecture decisions, technical discovery, backlog refinement, code review and production deploys.
Test-driven development with JUnit 5; end-to-end tests with Selenium.
